source.notes: No deadline is published. The NIIED programme page (fetched) carries Program Overview, Support period, Application Qualifications, Selection Procedure and Scholarship Benefits only. The official Study in Korea GKS portal likewise publishes no application deadline or selection schedule for the GKS Exchange Students Program; it states only that NIIED first selects the participating universities and then reviews candidates recommended by them, i.e. the application is administered by each affiliated university and no central deadline exists. Existing record value 'Varies by affiliated university' is directionally consistent with the source but is not quoted from it, so nothing is asserted.

records.title: UNSW International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (PUCA1025)
records.deadline_display: this application will open on 06 July 2026 and close at AEST 11:59PM on 30 October 2026

source.as_of: UNSW Scholarships for International Students Commencing Term 1, 2027 (PUCA1029); round status 'Open'
source.raw_extract: Opens 15/07/2026 Closes 30/10/2026 ... *This page and application process is for international students commencing their first term of studies at UNSW in Term 1 2027* ... **\*Please note this application will open on 06 July 2026 and close at AEST 11:59PM on 30 October 2026.** ... International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (PUCA1025) | Offer 1: Full tuition fee scholarship ... - Be commencing full-time study in a UNSW undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program (excluding UNSW online and UNSW Canberra) in Term 1, 2027.
source.notes: The official_source_url in the shard (https://scholarships.online.unsw.edu.au/scholarship/unsw-international-scientia-coursework-scholarship) returns HTTP 404 - it is not a live page. PUCA1025 has no standalone page of its own (https://www.scholarships.unsw.edu.au/international-scientia-coursework-scholarship-puca1025 also 404s); it is applied for through the parent PUCA1029 term-based round, and the award name appears verbatim in that round's award table. The currently open round (Term 1, 2027) closes 30 October 2026, which is in the future relative to the retrieval date 2026-10-05, so the record is genuinely open and the value is written. Note a same-page discrepancy in the OPENING date only (criteria block 'Opens 15/07/2026' vs body note 'will open on 06 July 2026'); both statements give the closing date as 30 October 2026, so the deadline itself is not in conflict. The prior Term 2, 2026 round closed 26 February 2026 and is superseded, so it is not used.

source.notes: www.eastwestcenter.org returns HTTP 403 to plain command-line fetches; the same live URL was fetched and read in a real browser session (HTTP 200) and the text above is quoted from that rendering. The shard's official_source_url (https://www.eastwestcenter.org/education/ewc-graduate-degree-fellowship) was also fetched in the browser: it renders the programme overview and the APPLY NOW / STUDENT LIFE / AWARD DETAILS / FAQs tabs but contains no deadline itself, so the official application page was used instead. Note a same-page discrepancy in the OPENING date only ('OPENING DATE Aug 16, 2026' vs 'will open on August 15'); every statement on the page gives the closing date as December 1 and the criteria block states 'CLOSING DATE Dec 1, 2026', so the deadline is unambiguous and is not a source conflict. 1 December 2026 is in the future relative to the retrieval date 2026-10-05, matching the record's '2027' label (academic year 2026-2027 competition). Separately, the EWC FAQ page fixes the automatic portal close at 11:59PM Hawai'i Standard Time on December 1.
